subject.title: fix(mattermost): proactive message tool sends ignore thread context

question: Which path should own the remaining Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread-context fix now that the message-tool half shipped?
rationale: The remaining bug is real, but the linked candidate branches are stale, conflicting, or broader than this issue, so automation should not choose between adoption, replacement, or closure without maintainer ownership.

options.title: Replace with a focused fix
options.body: Open or sponsor a narrow replacement that writes routable non-direct Mattermost delivery context on the correct session entry and includes live cron/heartbeat proof.

options.title: Adopt an existing candidate
options.body: Pick one linked PR, rebase it, address the known route/session risks, and use it as the canonical fix path.

options.title: Close remaining scope
options.body: Close this issue and associated candidates only if maintainers decide Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread recovery is no longer supported.

recommendation.title: Replace with a focused fix
recommendation.body: Open or sponsor a narrow replacement that writes routable non-direct Mattermost delivery context on the correct session entry and includes live cron/heartbeat proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the shipped message-tool fix and have recent adjacent history in the outbound route-threading path.
